title: Hot Climate Whisky
subtitle: Single malt from India and Taiwan
description: Amrut, Paul John and Kavalan make single malt in India and Taiwan. Casks lose far more to evaporation in the heat, so none of them puts an age on its standard bottle. Four pours: three of their malts and a 12-year-old Scotch.

pours.name: Amrut Fusion
pours.notes: Neat first, then a few drops of water. Notice how early the oak comes through.

pours.name: Paul John Brilliance
pours.notes: Indian six-row barley and ex-bourbon casks, with no peat. Taste it beside the Amrut.

pours.name: Kavalan Classic
pours.notes: The distillery’s first single malt, released in 2008. Look at the color from a distillery that began in 2006.

pours.name: Glenfiddich 12 Year Old
pours.notes: Twelve years in Speyside, losing about 2% a year. Compare it with the Kavalan.
